title.narrative: Les capacités institutionnelles des organisations d'employeurs sont renforcées

description.narrative:
The ILO is supporting the Association of Employers of Burundi (AEB) to strengthen its institutional capacity in response to the challenging political and economic environment. AEB faces significant obstacles, including a weak membership base, limited financial resources, and limited institutional capacity, all of which undermine its ability to effectively advocate for the interests of employers and promote a conducive business environment in the country.
To address these challenges, the ILO is helping AEB implement a comprehensive transformation strategy that includes enhancing leadership skills, improving governance structures, and increasing membership engagement. The programme will provide training based on a detailed SWOT analysis to help AEB's leadership make informed decisions regarding organizational development, service delivery, and advocacy.
The intervention is aligned with national and regional development frameworks and aims to build AEB’s ability to contribute effectively to social dialogue and tripartite discussions. Expected outcomes include the approval and implementation of a strategic plan for AEB, the adaptation of its organizational structure to better align with the changing business environment, and the development of a membership strategy to improve representation and influence.
By strengthening AEB's capacity, the programme will contribute to improving the overall business climate in Burundi, promoting productive and decent employment, and fostering stronger labor relations. This initiative will also help ensure that employers have a stronger voice in shaping economic and labor policies, ultimately contributing to more inclusive and sustainable economic growth in the country.
